name: gamepulse-ad-video
description: Renders the 30s GamePulse motion-graphics ad (1080x1920, 30fps) + its procedural soundtrack.

scripts.mux: ffmpeg -y -i out/video-silent.mp4 -i out/music.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -af volume=-0.7dB -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest -movflags +faststart out/gamepulse-ad-30s.mp4
scripts.build: npm run video && npm run audio && npm run mux
